{"id":"945f792a-95c7-4239-8137-6e4faaf0bb47","object":"chat.completion","created":1790482760,"model":"deepseek-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"obligation":"Identify the research paper published between 2012 and 2022 that has two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and also authored another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023, and that contains six tables, one of which reports an emotion at 13.53 percent."}","reasoning_content":"We need answer only JSON with obligation. Need derive one current Local Obligation.

We have Original Question: identify name of research paper given clues:
- written between 2012 and 2022.
- two people wrote it.
- One has another research paper in Journal of Baltic Science Education written between 2016 and 2023.
- As of 2023, one of writers was academic staff of Harran University.
- Six tables total each specific info. In one table, one emotion is at 13.53 percent.
- What is name?

Verified Claims: Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar is listed as professor on Harran University profile page.

Working hypothesis: Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar may be one of two authors.

Need choose ONE unresolved Local Obligation that materially advances. We must not jump downstream attribute if entity not identified. Current verified only says one person at Harran. Need establish relation between that person and target paper? Original asks name of paper. Clues: paper authored by two people; one has another paper in JOBSE 2016-2023; as of 2023 one writer academic staff Harran. Claim says Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar professor at Harran. But not established he is author of target paper. Obligation could be: identify the research paper (2012-2022, two authors) for which one author was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and who also authored another paper in Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023, and which contains six tables, one with an emotion at 13.53%. That's essentially final answer. But maybe too bundled? However one coherent objective: determine the name of the research paper satisfying all clues. Is that allowed? The obligation states what information must still be established. It can be combined conditions that jointly identify one object. Yes.

But maybe they expect local obligation not final? We need one unresolved Local Obligation. We have to choose one that would materially advance. Since original is identify paper, obligation likely: establish the identity/name of the research paper that matches the described conditions. But need avoid asking directly final? It's okay. But perhaps there is a more local obligation: identify the other research paper by Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar in Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023. But if we don't know Mehmet is author? Verified says he's professor at Harran, not that he's author. Hypothesis suggests he may be one. But rules: Don't turn hypothesized candidate into subject of downstream attribute. If we ask identify Mehmet's JOBSE paper, we are assuming he's candidate. That may violate. Instead obligation: identify the research paper (2012-2022) that has two authors, one of whom was academic staff of Harran University as of 2023 and also authored another research paper in JOBSE 2016-2023, and contains six tables including one where an emotion is 13.53%. This uses verified claim only to know someone at Harran exists? Actually the verified claim gives a candidate person. But obligation can mention Harran University academic staff, not specific person? The original clue says as of 2023 one writer was academic staff of Harran. Claim establishes Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar is professor at Harran. It doesn't establish he's the one among authors. But we can ask to identify the target paper that has two authors, one of whom was Harran academic staff as of 2023 and had another JOBSE paper 2016-2023, plus six tables and emotion at 13.53%. That is the object to identify. That is essentially final answer. But maybe the "emotion at 13.53%" is a downstream attribute of an unknown table in unknown paper. Since paper not identified, the obligation could be to identify the research paper whose table contains an emotion at 13.53%, along with other clues. That's final.

Maybe a more specific unresolved obligation: Establish whether Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar is one of the two authors of a research paper published between 2012 and 2022 that contains six tables, one of which reports an emotion at 13.53%, and for which the other author has another research paper in Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023. But that's a relation and conditions. But it still assumes Mehmet may be author from hypothesis? Not necessarily: Verified Claims says Mehmet is Harran professor. Original says one author was Harran academic staff as of 2023. To identify paper, we need establish relation between Mehmet and paper if he's the Harran staff. But since claim doesn't establish he authored paper, obligation can be "Identify the research paper (2012-2022) with two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and also authored another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023, and which contains six tables, including a table where one emotion is at 13.53 percent." This is the main objective.

But perhaps they want one local coherent research objective not final answer. We can choose: "Determine whether Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar is one of the two authors of a research paper published between 2012 and 2022 that has six tables and reports an emotion at 13.53% in one of them." But this is a relation between Mehmet and paper. Yet original clue: as of 2023 one writer was academic staff at Harran. Verified says Mehmet is Harran professor. So to use that clue, we need establish if Mehmet is indeed one of the writers. That is a local obligation. It directly advances. But the paper also requires the other author's JOBSE paper. But maybe not needed for this local obligation. If we establish Mehmet is author, then we can search paper. But the actual paper name still unknown. However the question asks name of paper. The obligation should be to identify the paper. Maybe the relation is more local.

Let's parse instructions carefully. "You derive one current Local Obligation for a research task." "Choose ONE unresolved Local Obligation that would materially advance answering the Original Question." "A Local Obligation states what information must still be established, not how to search for it." Requirements: must come directly from Original Question. Use Verified Claims to determine what's already established. Do not ask to establish something already sufficiently supported. Choose one local coherent research objective. It does not need to be logically atomic. Several complementary conditions may remain together when they jointly identify or verify one object, event, or relation. Do not bundle independent research objectives merely because they eventually contribute to same final answer. An unknown entity, event, relation, or value may itself be what the obligation asks to discover or verify. Do not require current unknown to already be established. Do not jump to downstream attribute when referenced entity not sufficiently identified. Preserve relation scope exactly. Do not use outside knowledge. Do not output search query, source preference, plan, hypothesis, confidence, rationale, requirement list, STOP. Return JSON obligation.

Working hypothesis provisional, not evidence, must not create/redefine obligation. Do not turn hypothesized candidate into subject of downstream attribute; assume hypothesized event/relation; replace generic question requirement with candidate-specific; treat hypothesis as satisfying condition.

So we need be careful not to make obligation about Mehmet. The hypothesis suggests Mehmet may be author. We should ignore it as evidence. The obligation should come from Original Question and Verified Claims. Verified Claims says Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar is listed as professor on Harran University profile page. That establishes one person at Harran. But original question says "As of 2023, one of the writers was the academic staff of Harran University." The claim doesn't say as of 2023, nor academic staff, just professor on profile page. But it does support existence of a Harran staff. However we cannot assume Mehmet is writer. So the obligation could be to identify the research paper satisfying all clues. That is directly from original. It does not use hypothesis. It doesn't assume Mehmet. It asks to discover/verify the paper. It includes all conditions jointly identifying one object. That seems safest.

But is it too broad? It is one object (the paper). It has complementary conditions. It is essentially the final answer. The instructions allow "Several complementary conditions may remain together when they jointly identify or verify one object, event, or relation." So yes.

Could also ask: "Identify the research paper published between 2012 and 2022, with two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and also had another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023, containing six tables, one of which includes an emotion at 13.53 percent." That is the obligation. It states what info must be established: the name of the paper. That's the final answer. But the system says "Do not perform complete coverage audit. Finding one useful unresolved obligation is sufficient." This is okay.

Maybe they want a more local obligation like "Identify which research paper by Mehmet Diyaddin Yaşar in Journal of Baltic Science Education was published between 2016 and 2023." But that assumes Mehmet has such paper. Hypothesis suggests. But not verified. If we ask that, we assume candidate-specific. The instructions explicitly: "Do not replace a generic question requirement with a candidate-specific requirement." So we should not use Mehmet in obligation unless verified as relevant. The only verified claim is Mehmet at Harran. But the original question requires one author was Harran academic staff. We can use that as generic. We don't need to name Mehmet. So obligation can be generic.

Thus final JSON: {"obligation": "Identify the research paper published between 2012 and 2022 that has two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and also authored another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education between 2016 and 2023, and that contains six tables, one of which reports an emotion at 13.53 percent."}

Check: It asks to identify the research paper. It includes all conditions. It doesn't mention Mehmet. It doesn't assume. It is one object. It is directly from Original Question. It doesn't say how to search. Good.

Potential issue: "one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023" - the verified claim says Mehmet is professor on Harran profile page. Does that establish academic staff? Not necessarily, but it's a clue. We can ask to verify which paper has such author. That's fine.

Could also ask: "Establish the name of the research paper that satisfies the following: published 2012-2022, two authors, one author was Harran University academic staff as of 2023 and had another JOBSE paper 2016-2023, six tables total, and one table shows an emotion at 13.53%." That's same.

We should output only JSON. Ensure valid JSON. No extra. Use double quotes.
